title: The Walk Home Started Too Fast
youtube_title: The Walk Home Started Too Fast | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Staying beside someone is sometimes the whole gift.
summary: At a bedroom rug of cushions, puppets, and paper, Casper is just outside the fun, close to a walk home that started before a slower friend had a shoe on. Eko changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Casper has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Papa lets the children solve it.
